## What it catches

Apps importing other apps.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "apps-do-not-import-other-apps",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^(apps/[^/]+)/"
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^apps/",
    "pathNot": "^$1/"
  }
}
```
